Traffic Advisory

A broken-down trailer @Buhimba in Kikuube District, near the Hoima–Kikuube border, has blocked the Hoima–Fort Portal road.

Motorists are advised to use the following diversions:-

Drivers coming from Kagadi to Hoima should divert @Makerere Competent H/School, Buhimba.

Drivers from Hoima should branch off at Buswekera & use the Kitoma–Kihukya road.

Efforts to remove the trailer are ongoing. Motorists are urged to remain patient & follow guidance from traffic officers.
